verdict.line: You lose if Irelia lands Flawless Duet (E) while stacked on her passive and chains into a Bladesurge (Q) kill before level 6; you win if you survive lane, itemize into Death's Dance, and start landing Blade of the Exile (R) picks in the mid-late game.

brief.thesis: Irelia's Ionian Fervor passive stacks bonus attack speed off spell hits and caps with bonus on-hit damage, so she wins short trades the moment she lands two spells on you. Her E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks at range 850, and a Marked target refreshes her Q (Bladesurge) on a kill — so one connected E can chain straight into a kill combo before you can respond. Riven's own tools are reactive here: Valor (E) only blocks, Ki Burst (W) only stuns at point-blank range 260, and Blade of the Exile (R) isn't a real threat until mid-game. The 54.9% win rate over 731 games reflects Riven out-scaling a lane she does not win outright.

theirWindow.what: At max stacks she gains bonus on-hit damage and wins extended trades she'd otherwise lose. Back off from prolonged auto exchanges and use Valor (E) to disengage rather than contest.

yourWindow.what: Flawless Duet is her only stun and sits on a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown, so a missed cast is a long window — close immediately with Broken Wings (Q) and land Ki Burst (W) before she can threaten again.

start.why: Highest win rate start at 55.4% over 827 games (94.5% pick) — the extra HP and sustain let you absorb Irelia's early poke without needing a second potion.

boots.why: 56.9% win rate over 404 games (49.2% pick) — the ability haste gets Valor (E) and Ki Burst (W) back up faster to answer her next Flawless Duet attempt.

core.why: First piece of the highest win-rate path, 66.7% over 93 games — cooldown refund on takedowns keeps Valor (E) and Broken Wings (Q) available for the trades she forces.
Second item in that 66.7% path — sustain and burst to offset the healing she gets off Bladesurge (Q).
Closes the path at 66.7% WR over 93 games — the damage-over-time conversion lets you survive the burst window right after her E (Flawless Duet) connects.

situational.when: you are ahead on kills and want to start Eclipse > Death's Dance > Endless Hunger instead (64.5% WR over 62 games)
the game goes long and you need the armor shred to keep killing through her Defiant Dance (W) damage reduction
you want more lane-phase trading power before committing to the Axiom Arc power spike

runes.keystoneWhy: 56.3% win rate at 37.1% pick — the stacking adaptive force and heal-on-hit is what lets you keep trading into a passive that out-scales you in short fights.

summoners.why: Run in 94.9% of games at 55.9% win rate — Ignite punishes the all-in Irelia goes for once she's stacked on passive, since you often won't have kill pressure without it.

playing.title: Track her passive stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed every time Irelia lands a spell, and caps with bonus on-hit damage — disengage before she reaches 5 stacks rather than trading into it.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed E
playing.detail: Flawless Duet (E) is her only stun and sits on 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown — if it misses, close immediately with Broken Wings (Q) and land Ki Burst (W) before she can threaten again.

playing.title: Save Valor for engage
playing.detail: Valor (E) blocks incoming damage for its short step — hold it to eat the Flawless Duet blades or the Bladesurge strike rather than burning it just to reposition.

playing.title: Don't feed Bladesurge resets
playing.detail: If you're Marked, or if Bladesurge (Q) kills you, its cooldown refreshes immediately — disengage above half health rather than trading into a kill-range Q.

playing.title: Poke with Q, don't engage
playing.detail: Broken Wings (Q) can be reactivated three times, with the third hit knocking back — per OP.GG's own read on this matchup, throw single casts to catch her off guard instead of dumping all three into an all-in.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not kills
playing.detail: Solo-kill advantage sits with Irelia this patch — farm the wave, hold Valor (E) defensively, and let Axiom Arc into Death's Dance carry you past level 12.

playing.title: Threaten with R once up
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile (R) grants bonus AD, range, and a one-time Wind Slash — once it's online at level 6, use the extended range to punish her for overextending without Flawless Duet available.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner spells are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the power-curve timing and trade reads are my own analysis of the kit interactions, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Always be careful when Irelia’s passive has 5 stacks. Focus on dodging Irelia’s (E) when engaging, and use your [Q] slowly to catch her off guard.
